analysis: The PR changes only AGENTS.md, which is contributor and agent process guidance. It rewords the modularity guidance, adds a Clean Code section and a Required Refactor Pass that uses a subagent, and adds PR diagram, signed-commit and docs-impact requirements. No runtime code, configuration, trust-boundary behavior, attestation, encryption, billing, or App Attest authorization path changes. I checked this against TB-001..TB-011, A-001..A-017 and T-001..T-058, including the supplied T-049 definition. I found no new attack surface, no invalidated assumption and no required threat-model update. The text says not to weaken tests, admission checks or security controls during refactoring, which is neutral to positive. Coverage limits: unit 1 shows only the excerpt starting near line 350, and base lines 342-357 appear only in the patch and the full base text unit. Unchanged callers were not examined. No cross-file interactions were identified.
